description: Périmètres d'agglomération de la Police de la circulation et du stationnement sur le territoire de Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Les Périmètres d'agglomération permettent de délimiter le pouvoir de police spéciale de la circulation et du stationnement sur le domaine public routier du territoire métropolitain. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are route, place de stationnement, pouvoir de police, parc de stationnement. The portal shows 88 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-10-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
